title: Companion App - Incorrect deltas / trend arrows and issues with the time it syncs
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3784
Originally posted by **petalina** November 26, 2024 Hello, since I switched from Dexcom One to Dexcom One+, using the Companion App as source, I have some issues with the arrows / difference of values and the time of update. I think somehow it is stuck in the time the older sensor used to update the values or something (eg some of the time points below - 1st pic: 8.47 / 103 mg/dl - 8.51 / 103 mg/dl - 8.56 / 103 mg/dl - 8.57 / 113 mg/dl, but delta: +41 mg/dl instead of 10 mg/dl) but I can't understand why the deltas it displays are so large even though the diagram and the values are correct. Also, at the same time the difference may be correct in the widget but with the wrong arrow (based on the real delta and xDrip's settings, not compared to the Dexcom app) and when I open the app both the arrow and difference are wrong. I installed the latest version of xDrip+ yesterday and also tried to Restart Collector and restart my phone. ![Screenshot 2024-11-26 162155](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f2d94112-a6f4-4ca9-bd7e-a27cec0d57fb) ![Screenshot 2024-11-26 163223](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/678a3092-1cc5-4e76-ad6f-90d6dd4a3e99)

@Qxlkdr @overfrenk 
The reason this issue was opened is the discrepancy between the difference between the last two xDrip readings and the xDrip delta value of 41 in the very first image in this thread.
If you look at that image, you can see that the difference between the last two readings is less than 41.  

However, xDrip is not supposed to show the delta or the trend arrow that Dexcom app or any other app shows.  xDrip is supposed to calculate the delta from the current and previous reading and calculate the arrow from that as well.
Dexcom app does not do that and uses a filer to come up with the arrow xDrip does not.  We are not trying to present Dexcom app's arrow in xDrip.  

If that is what you are interested in, you can open a discussion and we can talk about it.  
Any other post in this issue that is not about the real issue it represents may be ignored.

I'm having the same problem with the delay in Xdrip+ reading the notification in "companion app" mode. Most of the time, the value updates about 30 seconds before the next Carelink value changes. Since Carelink changes every 5 minutes, Xdrip+ has a delay of about 4 minutes and 30 seconds.

I don't think this happened a few months ago, or at least I didn't notice.

I've tried reinstalling everything and reconfiguring it, and it still happens. Sometimes it updates correctly, right on time, but most of the time it doesn't.

I am also getting this issue. The problem is that xDrip reads the data from the notification, but the data may be stale. Since readings are only accurate right when they happen, this causes some dissonance in the readings and delta. As an example: at 3:31 and 3:36 xdrip reads 82.7 mg/dl, but both are from the same sensor reading. then at 3:40 it picks up 79.0, which was actually taken minutes ago. then at 3:41 it picks up the new reading much earlier at 74.0. Because of the 1 minute gap between these readings, it produces a large probable delta, calculating it as a drop of 5 mg/dl in one minute. It fixes itself on the next read usually but this can cause confusion and false positives of low/high predictions and fall/climb rates, not to mention affecting suggested insulin/carb intake. At least for G7, the Dexcom app doesn't give time of reading or delta in the notification, so I'm not sure how this can be fixed programmatically, except maybe some increased scanning in the beginning to find where the actual update happens and then only accepting one read per 5 minutes aligned with that.
